details.detail: Sidewall panels and seams. Smooth satin wall, with a joint mid-pier after every second window. No gaps or z-fighting in s01, s02, s09 or win_*.

F/J bowl. The width and the pill position are right, and the grade is now darkest just above the opening, as in the photos. In the cabin the bowl just above the opening is 0.79 of the pier (b_jClose) against 0.74 (DSC_1920, omf_34). It is a two-level surround and reads well in q03, q12 and s09.

PY/Y tub. The tub is 0.83 of the pitch (y_47303 face-on: 0.83), and the above/below ratio is 1.30 (photo 1.41). The bezel over the tub is 0.745 (photo 0.68). The upper-tub grade is only 0.88 of the pier in the cabin, against 0.65-0.70 in sp_py14 and y_47303. The bezel frame is a soft roll, where the photos show a crisp 30 mm raised ring with a dark seam line (sp_py24, y_47303).
Pane tunnel lining and seal rim. A grey lining band now shows at 0.62 of the bezel (tt_window 0.64), with a thin blue-grey seal and no leaks.

F/J electric shades and button. The sheer and its pleat pitch are good, and the studio blackout is right (0.56). In the cabin the blackout is too dark and drab: it reads 0.41-0.53 of the sill (#5e5953), against omaat_room38's light warm grey #a39a8c (0.74) and Room-24 (0.64). The violet ring has the right hue but is pale.
PY/Y manual shade. The half and closed states are fine (win_front, s08). The stowed grip band is still invisible in the cabin: it renders at about the bezel tone with no shadow line.

Dado, grilles and placards. The dado is 0.25 m tall (py_37303 pitch-scaled 0.247). Its tone in the cabin is 0.37 of the wall, slate. The grilles are wide and low with a placard of the right size and contrast in the gap. The 8 ribs print a little too strongly.
Carpets, vinyl and track covers. The Y navy (#262f45 in q16) is right, and the F brown is h28. The door cross-aisle carpet is slightly red (h15 against sans_09's h30).

Type A door surround and viewing window. The proportions are right and the window is now glazed. The lining is a flat cream slab with little relief. The window position (0.28 m aft) remains unverified.

issues.detail: PY/Y bezel ring is soft and slightly large for its tub

The model rolls softly from the tub floor into the opening (scl 1.085 to 1.02 to 0.992), so the window lacks its frame read. The bezel over the tub is 0.745 against 0.68.
issues.evidence: y_47303 face-on middle window: tub 265 px, bezel 180 px (0.68), with a light ring and a dark outline. sp_py24: frame ring about 35 px on a 330 px-wide opening. Render pycmp (s02 against y_47303): there is no distinct frame ring.

issues.detail: Grille ribs print as a grid

issues.fix: src/07_shell.js line 357: rib offset 0.0045 -> 0.0022 (behind the slat lips). Line 129: WMAT.rib '#4a4e56' -> '#3f434b', close to grilleBack.

issues.problem: The door-zone carpet renders hue 15. The sans_09 door floor is a warmer olive-brown at hue 30.

issues.detail: Door lining is a flat slab; window position unverified
issues.problem: The door leaf and surround are one flat cream surface with only the window reveal and the monument furniture on it. Real Type A linings show a moulded upper panel and a separate lower bustle (the bustle is MONUMENTS). The window sits 0.28 m aft of the centre per the code comment (YouTube face-on). w5b's 'forward jamb' claim is not supported by any reference in the repo.
issues.evidence: b_doorWin, s06, b_dado. The fr_123806 and sans_09 crops are too blurred or occluded to locate the window.
issues.fix: Leave the window position as it is unless the user can supply a face-on door photo (see the question below). Add a 3 mm recessed panel line round the upper lining (lines 615-625, a second ringLoft at sc(1.6, 1.3) with MAT.doorGap) for relief.
